test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. 

Be in someone's shoes

options.text: face the same situation as another person
accept someone's shoes as a present
buy the same brand of shoes as another person

solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is '**face the same situation as another person.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **'Be in someone's shoes' **means acting for another person or experiencing something as anot
